sessions.phase_label: iOS screenshot and Android feature-graphic design, revision, and delivery

requirements.title: Fourteen-Screenshot iOS Phone Set
requirements.definition: Expand the existing set of 11 phone screenshots to 14 total, covering iOS phones while excluding iPad work.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the requested screenshot count and device-platform boundary. Independently revised content within particular screenshots is represented by separate sibling Requirements.

requirements.title: Smart Filtering Screenshot Image
requirements.definition: Use the updated 07-smart-filtering.png image in place of the previously attached image.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested source-image replacement is independently actionable and does not change the screenshot-set count or the content of other screenshots.

requirements.title: Suitable Character Expressions
requirements.definition: Present suitable character expressions in the first screenshot rather than expressions that appear upset or sad.
requirements.boundary_note: This visual-tone constraint can be revised and accepted independently of the filtering-content and Google TV screenshots.

requirements.title: Google TV Device Compatibility Message
requirements.definition: Make the sixth screenshot communicate that viewers can watch on any Google TV device.
requirements.boundary_note: This screenshot has its own communication objective and can be revised independently of the other screenshot content.

requirements.title: Android Play Store Feature Graphic
requirements.definition: Provide a separate Android Play Store feature graphic, identified during production as a 1024x500 asset.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the feature graphic as a deliverable and its dimensions. Its independently revised copy and logo alignment are represented by sibling Requirements.

requirements.title: Feature Graphic Copy
requirements.definition: Display the phrase "Choose a Safer View" under the logo and use "Smart safeguards that keep the whole household covered" as the bottom text.
requirements.boundary_note: The two text strings are coupled copy attributes of one graphic, while logo positioning is independently actionable and remains separate.

requirements.title: Feature Graphic Logo Alignment
requirements.definition: Center the Copper Finch logo over the "Choose a Safer View" phrase in the feature graphic.
requirements.boundary_note: The logo-positioning constraint was revised independently after the graphic copy was established and therefore has its own acceptance criterion.

unresolved_candidates.description: Ready-to-upload PNGs and an editable Figma file were delivered, but the supplied history contains no client-originated request clearly establishing those formats as independent deliverable Requirements.

source_message.text: Okay, I confirm that iPad is excluded, and I'm sending the contract now.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hey Darian, please replace the image I am attaching here with the updated version above, 07-smart-filtering.png.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Overall, this looks great, Darian. Please address the following comments:
1\. The first image works overall; however, the facial expressions look upset or sad. Please change them to something more suitable.
2\. At the top, remove the violence pill but retain nudity, kissing and profanity. The top photo currently shows active kissing, so please either hide it or use a photo that suggests kissing without actually showing it.
3, 4, 5: No changes are needed; they look good.
6\. Please replace this with something that communicates you can watch on any Google TV device.
